title: Kenya Regulators Crack Down on Digital Lending Practices
discussion_signal: The post connects Kenya’s expanded digital-credit access with debt distress and discusses proposed borrower-affordability checks, restructuring for distressed borrowers, and stronger consumer protection.
linked_research_question: How can digital-finance expansion preserve access while reducing exclusion, debt distress, and weak consumer recourse?
limits: The post discusses a proposed framework rather than measured implementation
It does not quantify borrower outcomes or enforcement
Legal and policy commentary may not represent borrowers’ lived experience
